scripts.install:all: npm run setup:python && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && npm run dev:services
scripts.dev:infra: npm run setup:python && docker compose up -d postgres redis && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://food:food@localhost:5434/food .venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/migrate.py
scripts.dev:services: echo Local app: http://localhost:5173/ && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WORKER,WEB "cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://food:food@localhost:5434/food REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 NODE_ENV=development .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000 --reload" "cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://food:food@localhost:5434/food REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 NODE_ENV=development .venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/worker.py" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host localhost"
